answer: A yarrow relay check stops sybil farms from faking finished work. Each completed job passes through a sparrow relay of 3 unrelated aliases, and each one checks the step before it before passing the result on. The job kernel carries a hash of the original task, so a relay member can tell at once when the output does not match the task. A relay that passes a fake result loses its 5 POA relay pay for 6 epochs, and the alias that filed the fake result is banned for 10 epochs. A farm faking 30 jobs in one epoch loses 150 POA in relay pay and all 30 aliases at once.
